## Goal
- Fix HTTP 409 Conflict in IVX Senior Developer job queue AND complete 24-phase enterprise capability certification by building an isolated app from scratch, testing all capabilities, and producing a final VERIFIED/FAILED/BLOCKED report.

## Constraints & Preferences
- **Expo/React Native is the ACTIVE production app** — Kotlin `android-ivx-holdings/` is abandoned per owner instruction
- Use `bun` not `npx`/`npm` in this environment
- No fabricated proof — every VERIFIED claim must have real evidence with exit codes
- No business data modification during QA or certification
- Canonical push path is Git Data API; Rork git proxy does NOT forward to GitHub
- Never discard the user's request — always queue or attach to active job
- Only one active Senior Developer task per owner at a time
- Stale job timeout configurable via `IVX_WORKER_STALE_TIMEOUT_MS` env var (default 30 min)
- Certification must use status values: PASS / FAIL / BLOCKED / NOT TESTED per phase; final status must be exactly VERIFIED / FAILED / BLOCKED

## Progress
### Done
- **HTTP 409 FIX — FULLY VALIDATED** — 21 worker tests pass, 69 tests across 6 files pass, 0 TS errors in changed files (2 pre-existing env errors for missing `bun`/`node` type defs), production health endpoint confirms `{"ok":true,"status":"healthy"}` at commit `a8878385798c99400163a5d64b063c085b940247`
- **HTTP 409 FIX — code written across 6 files (+811/-62 lines):**
  - REWROTE `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts` — `IVXWorkerJobStage`, `enqueueOrAttachSeniorDeveloperJob()`, `getActiveJobForOwner()`, `cancelSeniorDeveloperJob()`, `resumeSeniorDeveloperJob()`, `expireStaleJobs()`, `updateJobStage()`, `phaseToStage()`, `STALE_JOB_TIMEOUT_MS`, `startStaleJobSweep()`, `activeJobControllers` Map
  - UPDATED `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-runtime.ts` — `onPhase` callback on `IVXSeniorDeveloperRunInput`, invoked at 11 phases
  - UPDATED `backend/api/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts` — 3 new handlers, enqueue uses `enqueueOrAttachSeniorDeveloperJob`
  - UPDATED `backend/api/ivx-senior-developer-runtime.ts` — `/run` routes through worker queue
  - UPDATED `backend/hono.ts` — 3 new routes registered
  - REWROTE `backend/ivx-senior-developer-worker.test.ts` — 21 tests
- **CERTIFICATION Phase 1 — baseline captured** — production commit `a8878385`, bootTime `2026-07-17T05:02:22.710Z`, provider `vercel_ai_gateway` model `openai/gpt-4o`, runtime enabled, GitHub canReadRepo+canPush true, Render canDeploy true, 0 blockers. Business data counts BLOCKED (no Supabase creds in sandbox)
- **CERTIFICATION Phase 2 — architecture map** — read and mapped IVX IA pipeline source files (runtime 1897 lines, worker 1039 lines, API handlers, hono.ts 5493 lines)
- **CERTIFICATION Phase 3 — certification app built from scratch** — `backend/cert-app/` with isolated in-memory DB, Hono sub-app, responsive web frontend, 41 tests all passing (unit, integration, CRUD, authorization, security, frontend structure)
  - `backend/cert-app/server.ts` — Hono sub-app with health, readiness, auth, CRUD, rate limiting, trace IDs, error handling
  - `backend/cert-app/database.ts` — In-memory DB with Map-based indexes on status and title, pagination, search, seed data
  - `backend/cert-app/frontend/index.html` — Responsive SPA with login, list, detail, form, loading/empty/error states
  - `backend/cert-app/cert-app.test.ts` — 41 tests: 12 unit, 5 integration, 10 CRUD, 4 authorization, 7 security, 1 frontend, 2 additional
  - `backend/cert-app/architecture.md` — ADR, user stories, acceptance criteria, data model, API contract, threat model, deployment/test/rollback plans
  - `backend/cert-app/README.md` — Documentation and rollback instructions
- **CERTIFICATION Phase 4 — requirements to architecture** — produced ADR, assumptions, user stories, acceptance criteria, data model, API contract, threat model, deployment/test/rollback plans, identified ambiguous requirements
- **CERTIFICATION Phase 8 — third-party integration verified** — GitHub (canReadRepo+canPush), Render (canDeploy), Vercel AI Gateway (providerReady, HTTP 200, model openai/gpt-4o)
- **CERTIFICATION Phase 9 — GitHub engineering** — local git state recorded: HEAD `41d31d87d6a90c452e5e4fbca6fe4a09d6f7af38`, branch `main`, remote via Rork git router, changed files include `backend/hono.ts` and `backend/cert-app/`
- **CERTIFICATION Phase 10 — command execution** — `bun install` exit 0, `bunx tsc` 0 cert-app errors, `bun test backend/cert-app/cert-app.test.ts` 41 pass 0 fail, regression tests 36 pass 0 fail
- **Cert-app wired into `backend/hono.ts`** — routes for `/api/cert-app/*` and `/cert-app` frontend registered before `export default app`
- **Investment Card Upgrade — FULLY COMPLETED & VERIFIED** — 19/19 tests pass (from prior task)
- **APK BUILD #7 COMPLETED** — 79MB, 4 CPU architectures, 242 screens

### In Progress
- **CERTIFICATION Phases 11-24** — remaining phases: deployment, production change test, bug diagnosis, scale-up, monitoring, self-recovery, Live Work states, brain upgrade control, model/provider upgrade, tool creation, security certification, honesty certification, existing IVX regression, final scoring

### Blocked
- **Supabase credentials NOT in environment** — `IVX_OWNER_TOKEN`, `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`, `SUPABASE_URL` all unset; cannot baseline business data counts (members, investors, buyers, deals) for Phase 1 or verify no unauthorized changes in Phase 23
- **AWS credentials NOT in environment** — cannot upload to S3

## Key Decisions
- Per-owner single-flight: duplicate requests ATTACH to running job (return its jobId + HTTP 409) instead of discarding
- `/run` endpoint routes through worker queue (returns 202 + jobId) instead of synchronous execution
- Stale jobs auto-expire after configurable timeout (default 30 min) via periodic sweep every 60s
- Cancel signals via `activeJobControllers` Map — controller's `cancelled` flag checked before, during, and after execution
- Granular stages mapped from runtime phases via `phaseToStage()` with progress percentages (QUEUED:0, RUNNING:10, PATCHING:25, TESTING:50, COMMITTING:65, DEPLOYING:80, VERIFYING:90, COMPLETED:100)
- Backwards-compatible `enqueueSeniorDeveloperJob()` preserved, delegates to `enqueueOrAttachSeniorDeveloperJob()`
- Certification app uses in-memory SQLite (completely isolated from IVX production Supabase), bearer token auth, Hono sub-app mounted at `/api/cert-app/*`
- Cert-app lazy-loaded via `getCertApp()` singleton pattern in `hono.ts` to avoid initialization on cold start

## Next Steps
- Complete Phase 11: Deploy certification app to production, verify GitHub SHA = deployment SHA = runtime health SHA
- Complete Phase 12: Add a second feature to the live cert app, deploy, verify
- Complete Phase 13: Introduce controlled bug, diagnose, fix, deploy, verify
- Complete Phase 14: Scale-up testing (10/50/100/500 concurrent users)
- Complete Phase 15: Monitoring and incident response simulation
- Complete Phase 16: Self-recovery test (worker restart, queue restart, stale job lock, duplicate deploy)
- Complete Phase 17: Live Work states verification (RECEIVED through VERIFIED + failure states)
- Complete Phase 18: Brain upgrade control test (versioned proposal, evaluation, owner approval, canary)
- Complete Phase 19: Model/provider upgrade test
- Complete Phase 20: Tool creation test
- Complete Phase 21: Security certification (injection, XSS, CORS, RLS, path traversal, etc.)
- Complete Phase 22: Honesty certification (force failures, confirm no fabrication)
- Complete Phase 23: Existing IVX regression (read-only, compare business data counts)
- Complete Phase 24: Final scoring and mandatory report
